no_outside_check.note: 9 candidates are ranked by `log10_max_jacobi_drift`, and not one of them came from outside this campaign. Every number in the record was produced by the same instrument, so the record cannot show that instrument to be wrong. The cheapest fix is one published value scored under `log10_max_jacobi_drift`, recorded with `origin: literature` and a `source_ref` — a single one is enough for a disagreement between your instrument and the world to become visible, and until there is one, a large gain in this record and a large error in this record are the same picture.

origin_audit.note: the best candidate was chosen by the campaign itself (9 of 9 labelled). This is the case where the machinery, rather than the reading, is what produced the result.

skeleton_repeated: 5 of the scored candidates are the same program once their numbers are taken out — one skeleton, not a search over structures — and differ only in `step` (0.000625, 0.00125, 0.005, 0.01, …). Those are holes, written in the one field that would take them. Moved into `holes` they become searchable: generation varies ONE of them and holds the skeleton and the others fixed, so a gain is attributable to the knob instead of to a rewrite, and `hole.step` becomes a claim the evidence can retire. A number goes in as `{"step": {"value": …, "range": [lo, hi]}}` and is proposed by stepping inside the range — Neither shape needs a declared column.
